class.name: flir_boson_usb/RadiometricFilter
class.description: Turn the raw 16-bit counts of a radiometric Boson into 32-bit float absolute temperatures. The gain the counts were produced with and the unit of the result are given by the gain and output_unit parameters of the filter. A non-radiometric camera can at least use the "counts" output_unit to get the number of raw counts compensated for gain switching.
class.author: Czech Technical University in Prague
